children: New Home Cinema Models Expand Big-Screen Possibilities for DIY Home Theater Enthusiasts with Bright 4K HDR Performance and Flexible Installation

LOS ALAMITOS, Calif., Sept. 22, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- As home entertainment continues to evolve, consumers are looking to upgrade their viewing setups to enjoy bigger, brighter and more immersive 4K HDR experiences for movies, gaming, and sports. Expanding its
, Epson today introduced the new Home Cinema

and LS7500 4K HDR laser projectors – powered by its unique 3-Chip 3LCD technology – making it easier than ever for DIY home theater enthusiasts to upgrade from older lamp-based projectors or create a new big-screen entertainment experience in virtually any home setting. The new lineup complements Epson's established Home Cinema projector portfolio, including the flagship Home Cinema LS11000 4K HDR 3-Chip 3LCD Laser Projector, delivering Epson's highest level of picture quality and contrast within the Home Cinema lineup. Together, Epson now offers a complete Home Cinema 4K HDR projector lineup with solutions designed for a wide range of home entertainment spaces and viewing preferences.
Epson's New Home Cinema 3-Chip 3LCD Laser Projectors Make Big-Screen Entertainment Easier Than Ever

"As TVs get bigger, they can also become a design challenge, leaving a large black rectangle that dominates the room when not in use. Projection offers a discreet alternative that virtually disappears when the entertainment ends, while creating immersive experiences, not possible with a traditional TV – from every day 16:9 content to cinematic 21:9 and IMAX®-style viewing," said Fernando Tamashiro, product manager, Epson America, Inc. "By expanding our Home Cinema lineup with these new 4K HDR laser projectors, we're offering an even broader range of solutions for today's home entertainment spaces. Combining our unique 3-Chip 3LCD technology with our latest laser light source, Epson projectors are the optimal choice for customers looking to create a big-screen experience tailored to their viewing preferences, space and budget."

Designed for everything from blockbuster movies and immersive gaming to live sports, Epson's new Home Cinema laser projector lineup delivers stunning 4K HDR entertainment in virtually any room. Powered by an advanced Epson Picture Processor, Proprietary 4K Display Technology¹ that produces a full 8.29-million-pixel on-screen image, plus a unique 3-Chip 3LCD projection engine powered by a laser array light source, the new models produce 2,500 to 3,500 lumens of equal Color Brightness (IDMS Rated) and White Brightness (ISO Rated)² for a bright, vivid, immersive picture with exceptional color accuracy and deep black levels.

Built to deliver sharp, edge-to-edge images on screens up to 300 inches, the new Home Cinema projectors make it easy to create a true cinematic experience at home. The Home Cinema LS5000 and LS6000 use a high-quality Epson Cinema lens, while the Home Cinema LS7500 features a unique short-throw lens that allows the projector to be positioned a few feet closer to the wall than conventional projectors, making it ideal for larger screen sizes in rooms with limited depth. Plus, with support for multiple aspect ratios – from 16:9 HDTV to cinematic 21:9 – the new projectors deliver an immersive viewing experience that standard TVs simply can't match.

The new Home Cinema projectors combine outstanding performance with flexible installation and seamless integration into a wide range of home entertainment spaces. A compact, whisper-quiet design with front-exiting airflow and wide-range manual lens shift provide greater placement flexibility, while dual HDMI® ports support 4K HDR content up to 120Hz for smooth, ultra-clear movies, sports and gaming. In addition, high refresh rates and Auto Low Latency Mode (ALLM) further reduce input lag and screen tearing to ensure responsive gameplay and cinematic playback exactly as the director intended. Plus, for quiet late-night viewing, integrated Bluetooth® 6.0 makes it easy to connect wireless headphones and enjoy a private viewing experience.

From the world's best-selling projector brand, the new Home Cinema lineup offers an ideal solution for anyone looking to create a stunning 4K HDR home theater experience that will deliver years of entertainment. Additional features include:
4K Display Technology
— Produces a full 8.29-million-pixel on-screen image for exceptional picture clarity without sacrificing brightness
Advanced HDR Capability
— Full 10-bit color processing for HDR, HDR103 and HLG content, including the option for Epson Automatic HDR Scene Correction for optimized picture quality
High Black Contrast
— Deep dynamic contrast ratios – from 800,000:1 to 1,200,000:1 – produce an overall sharper picture, while revealing deeper shadow detail and sharper distinction between light and dark scenes
Modern Connectivity
— Dual HDMI ports support refresh rates up to 120Hz, with one HDMI port featuring eARC for high-quality audio passthrough
Built for Gaming

— Featuring a 120Hz refresh rate and Auto Low Latency Mode (ALLM) with input lag below 20ms, this gaming projector delivers smooth, responsive gameplay perfect for the latest generation of consoles and gaming PCs
Flexible Installation

— Compact, whisper-quiet front-exiting airflow design and a manual lens shift (±21% horizontal and ±59% vertical) for greater placement flexibility and easier integration into a wide range of environments
Wireless Audio

— Integrated Bluetooth® 6.0 on the Home Cinema LS5000, LS6000 and LS7500 models support optional two-channel audio streaming directly from HDMI input sources, making it ideal for connecting personal headphones
Availability

The Home Cinema LS11000 ($4,499.99 MSRP) is available now and the new Home Cinema LS7500 ($2,699.99 MSRP), LS6000 ($2,199.99 MSRP) and LS5000 ($1,999.99 MSRP) will be available in late September through the Epson online store and select retailers. The new Home Cinema projectors include Epson's world-class warranty and support, including a standard two-year limited warranty with full unit replacement and free technical support.
